item.title: Repository delivery
item.description:
repo_delivery implements the deterministic part of repository delivery. It invokes native Git and a selected forge CLI; it does not infer task ownership, choose validation commands, resolve conflicts, or judge review feedback.

Status and immutable changed-path inventories, and preparation receipts, support complete output up to 4 MiB so large source relocations can use the guarded workflow. Stable reads and writes enforce that limit; other typed local records retain their 256 KiB limit. Receipt schema, scope, integrity, and publication checks apply at either size.
